newsitem.title: CHINA: China Travel may up Sun Fook Kong offer.
newsitem.headline: China Travel may up Sun Fook Kong offer.

text.p: Sun Fook Kong Holdings Ltd said on Thursday the cash offer price for all the company's outstanding shares and warrants would be increased if Albert Chow subscribed for company shares at the higher price.
The cash offer price will be increased to HK$1.38 per Sun Fook Kong share from HK$1.08, and to HK$0.53 per warrant from HK$0.23, the company said in a statement.

The statement said Chow was anticipated to subscribe for 66.87 million new shares at HK$1.38 per share on completion of the purchase by China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Ltd of a 51.66 percent holding in Sun Fook Kong.
